Special mention to Eva Kaisti, who focused on our dog's long-term heartburn so thoroughly that we were extremely satisfied and even amazed. Vetsy was the first place that did not offer heartburn medicine but wanted to treat the root cause. The heartburn has also stayed under control.
The needs of even a reactive dog are taken into account and the lobby is cleared so that we can get inside without too much confusion. We have always been satisfied when we have visited. All the nurses are also really cordial 🙏🏻❤️💯 We will not go to the doctor anywhere else unless we have to. I recommend 6/5!

Miina & Manu have been customers of Vetsy since Vetsy opened in Munkkiniemi. The service has been excellent and help has always been received for both small and large ailments. Vetsy's staff has also been a great support to the couple's service staff, especially during Miina's rather eventful youth. The prices are also competitive. I warmly recommend Vetsy to everyone who wants the best care for their pets :)
Thank you and have a wonderful summer!
We have been regularly using Vetsy's services since spring 2023. We have been satisfied.
Eva is certainly the most reliable veterinarian who has treated our dogs. She has a truly caring personality and versatile expertise.

Our experiences with Vetsy veterinary clinic have been super good. We have used Vetsy for several years now. All activities are expert and caring, both over the phone and during visits. And what is not necessarily insignificant, the premises are comfortable, clean and peaceful. The animal is the focus there and their well-being is genuinely taken care of. The written comments about the visit and the descriptions of the examinations/treatment instructions receive special praise for their clarity and comprehensiveness. There has never been a feeling that examinations or procedures are being forced on. Consequently, the billing has also been reasonable and understandable.
💜🩷 It's a pleasure to be of help! …

Our dog had intestinal surgery here and I would like to thank the entire staff at the clinic for their excellent work. Everything was handled professionally and with care and the dog is now doing well. Warm thanks for the friendly and caring service!
Always and forever: competent, friendly, empathetic

Professional, friendly and very warm service. The premises are clean and modern. You can easily park your car near the door. It is easy to make an appointment online.
My puppy didn't even notice when he got vaccinated. Vetsy became our own medical clinic.

I visited my cat twice because of a severe ear disease. Bea the cat was treated professionally, kindly and caring. I received instructions for home care and treatment that were really comprehensive. A clean and nice place in Munkka near me.
The prices were surprising and there were no prices online at all. I was unhappy when I couldn't pay in cash. And because the cat needed a collar for its treatment, it wasn't available. It had to be obtained elsewhere. One day the calls went to voicemail for several hours when I needed urgent answers. Otherwise, a good place overall 😻👍

Vetsy with its wonderful caregivers and great doctors is the absolute number one place for our 6 cats 🐱🐱🐱🧡.
We have visited Vetsy in Munkka from the very beginning for many different things, vaccinations and illnesses and have always gotten an appointment quickly, the telephone advice and reception have had an unhurried, caring and pet-respecting atmosphere. Reliable and professional service, the best for your beloved pet 🐱🧡😊. Highly recommended!!!

Our dog had a malignant melanoma in his mouth. It was discovered when he was at Vetsy for a dental check-up. The vet said it would be a good idea to remove the tumor and the molars next to it. The surgery was major, recovery took some time, but he has now recovered well and is really lively and cheerful. Big thanks to the Vetsy team!

I have been going to Vetsy for several years with my two senior cats. Vetsy's veterinarians have investigated Ringo's strange gait, coughing fits and daily vomiting, which is more symptomatic. The cause was found out on the first visit and the cats were always cured with a treatment plan, except for one more complicated case. Most of the time, the veterinarian also considered other possible factors for the symptoms and made easy and precise instructions on how to improve the cat's condition.

Vetsy has a calm atmosphere and the cats have their own room, where you can wait alone with the cat for the nurse/doctor to arrive.
Not once have I felt rushed, unlike in larger clinics (no blood tests or X-rays were done unless there was a real reason for the matter), and the price corresponds well to the quality of the service. A few times I have also received a discount when the other cat, Lugi, had a long-term persistent lack of appetite, which is why he had to be taken to the clinic more often. The appointment was easy to make and the doctor was flexible with the time, for which I am very grateful!

Vetsy has been a great veterinary clinic for me and I use it whenever I have concerns about my cats. I don't often write reviews, but I wanted to make an exception for Vetsy because they have helped me with challenging cases for years and I want to support a skilled small business, especially in these times when big companies are eating smaller ones and veterinary clinics are becoming more and more monopolized by big companies.
Thank you and have a wonderful Christmas!

Always warm and friendly service. The last time we received help for an acute chipped tooth, the knowledgeable and empathetic staff took care of us again. Thank you very much ❤️ Sofi and her family thank you.
